provenance.primary_origin: NCI Genomic Data Commons (GDC) TARGET-WT project
provenance.transformations_applied: GDC-derived alignments recomputed on hg38, wrangled and standardized by UCSC Xena GDC ETL pipelines. Features filtered and aligned to Reactome pathway knowledge graph and miRBase.
provenance.access_tier: Open Access (Tier 1 public, no dbGaP required)

cohort_summary.inclusion_criteria: Primary solid tumor patients (sample type 01A/01B) with complete, aligned mRNA-seq, miRNA-seq, Illumina Human Methylation 450k, and clinical metadata.

primary_task.name: Histologic Subtype Classification
primary_task.clinical_significance: Anaplasia is the primary histological determinant of chemotherapy resistance and clinical recurrence in pediatric nephroblastoma.

secondary_task_exploratory.name: Vital Status Classification
secondary_task_exploratory.caveat: Alive patients in GDC TARGET-WT lack recorded post-diagnosis follow-up times (days_to_last_follow_up is NaN). 'Alive' indicates not known dead in the registry. Cox survival regression is not statistically valid for this cohort.

excluded_tasks: Cox proportional hazards / time-to-event survival regression (invalid follow-up data for living patients)
Biological sex / gender prediction control task (clinically non-informative)

mrna.filtering: Intersection with Reactome pathway genes, non-zero variance filtered.

mirna.filtering: Stem-loop precursors mapped to mature miRBase identifiers via hsa.gff3 and filtered to broad miRNA target prior.

methylation.unit: Beta value (ratio of methylated probe intensity)
methylation.filtering: Gene promoter region CpGs (TSS1500, TSS200, 5'UTR, 1stExon) averaged to gene-level beta; top 20,000 variable non-sex chromosome CpGs.

pathway_activity.coverage: 1,708 mRNA pathways and 1,660 DNA methylation pathways spanning 2,883 Reactome pathways (depths 1-13).

cross_validation.protocol: Repeated Stratified 5-Fold Cross-Validation (5 repeats x 5 folds = 25 test folds)
cross_validation.leakage_guarantee: All scaling, missing-value imputation, and feature screening fitted strictly inside outer and inner training folds.

frozen_model_v1.pathway_criteria: Reactome hierarchy depth <= 4, member feature count 10-300, top 192 ranked by cohort expression variance

mirna_deduplication.unmapped_fallback_token: partial: features without an edge are wired into the LAST SELECTED PATHWAY token (index P-1), not a dedicated token; see forking_paths.md Fork 6

frozen_model_v1.methylation_status: no detectable signal for histology (non-separable HM450 beta values)
frozen_model_v1.parameter_note: Free parameters = 47,221; dense masked weights = 4,249,284 (of which 18,865 mask non-zeros). 62,450 appeared in an earlier draft and could not be reproduced.
frozen_model_v1.run_history: E1 run twice: unseeded (AUROC 0.8460, discarded) then seeded (0.8716, stored). See results/model/forking_paths.md Fork 5.
frozen_model_v1.experiments_note: E2-E10 (ablations) archived in git tag v1-archive-all-experiments; exploratory only.

clinical.source: GDC API (/cases endpoint and open-access clinical supplements)

lineage_note: Omics matrices (mRNA, miRNA, methylation) are GDC-derived data obtained through the UCSC Xena GDC hub (hg38, Xena-transformed: mRNA log2(count+1), miRNA log2(RPM+1), methylation beta). Clinical labels come from the GDC API (scripts/download_clinical.py, scripts/build_labels.py). A GDC-native rebuild of the omics matrices has not been done; doing so requires re-running E1.
